As we're approaching the screening, I want to make sure we're all aligned on the public-screening protocol. The current draft includes the full interview segment and a conventional open-floor audience question period, and I have final authority to approve that protocol. I'd like to hear from each of you on where things stand so we can make sure everything is ready before press materials go out.

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we proceed. This morning I reviewed a signed amendment from the interview subject — it permits public screening only with the subject's face blurred and name omitted. I have not yet added this amendment to the master clearance memo, so the current clearance packet does not reflect this restriction.

transcript.text: I need to flag something on the logistics side. I confirmed with the Calder Cinema's event technician that the room cannot support an open-floor microphone setup.
